name: Duplicati
description: Encrypted backups to the cloud or another disk.
compose:
services:
  duplicati:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/duplicati:latest
    container_name: duplicati
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:8200"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "{TZ}"
      SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY: "{SECRET2}"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/config:/config
      - /srv/backups:/backups
      - /home:/source/home:ro
